page.overview:
Who is Fred Gamble?

Fred Gamble (born 17 March 1932) is a former American racing driver who participated in the 1960 Italian Grand Prix as a Formula Two entry. He finished 10th in the race. He was also Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company's first European racing manager.
